request.summary: Narrow LootAlertListener's TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS allowlist to the 3 mega rares (Twisted bow, Scythe of vitur, Tumeken's shadow), Ancient blood ornament kit, and Purifying sigil - removing Mokhaiotl cloth, Eye of Ayak (uncharged), and Avernic treads, which were incorrectly firing ACCOMPLISHMENT alerts for what should just be regular loot.
request.raw_requirements:
In C:\Development\cata-osrs\cata-runelite-plugin, narrow LootAlertListener's TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS allowlist (src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/alerts/LootAlertListener.java). A Mokhaiotl cloth drop from Doom of Mokhaiotl was incorrectly posted as an ACCOMPLISHMENT alert (screenshot evidence: title "Mokhaiotl cloth", body "received Mokhaiotl cloth from Doom of Mokhaiotl"). Developer's explicit correction: only the 3 mega rares (Twisted bow, Scythe of vitur, Tumeken's shadow), the Ancient blood ornament kit, and the (Yama) radiant/Purifying sigil should count as accomplishments.

Fix: remove MOKHAIOTL_CLOTH, EYE_OF_AYAK_UNCHARGED, and AVERNIC_TREADS from TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS (these were added during the consolidate-loot-listeners task as Doom of Mokhaiotl's "big 3" drops - that inclusion is being reversed as out of scope for accomplishments), and add ItemID.PURIFYING_SIGIL (the assembled sigil from Yama's 5 contract pieces, used to unlock the Radiant Oathplate cosmetic - confirmed untradeable/unpriced via the OSRS Wiki, so it would never be caught by the generic loot-value threshold check and needs the fixed allowlist to ever alert). Final TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS: TWISTED_BOW, SCYTHE_OF_VITUR, TUMEKENS_SHADOW, ANCIENT_BLOOD_ORNAMENT_KIT, PURIFYING_SIGIL. Removed items (Mokhaiotl cloth, Eye of Ayak uncharged, Avernic treads) still get alerted via the normal LOOT value-threshold path if they're non-stackable and worth >= 1.5m gp, same as any other loot.

Clarified during intake: developer also wants mega-rare/accomplishment items to double-post to the loot channel when they qualify - confirmed this already works today with no code change needed, since LootAlertListener.handleLoot()'s LOOT and ACCOMPLISHMENT checks are two fully independent `if` blocks (not if/else) - a non-stackable item worth >= 1.5m gp already triggers both alerts when both lootSharingEnabled and accomplishmentSharingEnabled are on. Developer confirmed this is the desired behavior (only double-post when the item independently clears the value threshold - untradeable items like Purifying sigil are not expected to ever get a loot-channel post). No change needed for this part; scope stays limited to the allowlist swap.

plan.approach: Single-collection edit in LootAlertListener.java: swap the TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS Set.of(...) contents and update the WRN-008 concern note to reflect the new 5-entry count (down from 7).
steps: Step 1 - LootAlertListener.java TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS: change to {TWISTED_BOW, SCYTHE_OF_VITUR, TUMEKENS_SHADOW, ANCIENT_BLOOD_ORNAMENT_KIT, PURIFYING_SIGIL}.
Step 2 - ./gradlew compileJava to confirm clean compile and ItemID.PURIFYING_SIGIL resolves.
Step 3 - .mflow/concerns.json: update WRN-008 to say 'all 5 entries' instead of 'all 7 entries'.

verification.notes: No open blockers. Diff scoped to LootAlertListener.java's TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS swap plus the WRN-008 wording update. Conventions followed, no new concerns. Live functional confirmation (Purifying sigil actually triggering ACCOMPLISHMENT) deferred to the next real drop, since it's untradeable and can't be simulated - same residual-risk pattern as other mega-rare/pet alert wording in this repo.
